Among the most dangerous of their kind are the fiery magma worms. In addition to being even larger than benthic worms, the magma worm has a penchant for burrowing through volcanic regions that, over the generations, have infused it with a supernatural link to the Elemental [Plane of Fire](/Planes.aspx?ID=31). The fiery heart of an active volcano is an attractive lair for a magma worm, as are the sprawling fields of molten rock found in the deepest reaches of the Darklands. Legends of ancient dwarven societies and colonists of the Elemental Planes populating moats of lava with magma worms likely have some basis in truth, although the methods used to keep these “moat worms” contained—and prevented from chewing their way through fortress foundations—must have been significant. Magma worms sometimes frequent areas on the surface where volcanism creates hot springs or other geothermal features, but even then they prefer to spend most of their time burrowing through the ground in their never-ending search for sustenance. Surface lands claimed by magma worms are notable for the mound-shaped burrows these creatures leave behind as they dig. **[Recall Knowledge - Beast](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)** ([Arcana](/Skills.aspx?ID=35), [Nature](/Skills.aspx?ID=43)): DC 43 **[Unspecific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 41 **[Specific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 38 [Magma Worm](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2873) **Source** [Monster Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=221) pg. 57 **Perception** +25; [darkvision](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=59), [tremorsense](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=82) ([imprecise](/Rules.aspx?ID=412)) 100 feet **Languages** **Skills** [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) +38 **Str** +10 **Dex** -1 **Con** +9 **Int** -3 **Wis** -1 **Cha** -1 --- **AC** 40 **Fort** +36 **Ref** +25 **Will** +27 **HP** 410 **Immunities** [fire](/Traits.aspx?ID=604) **Weaknesses** [cold](/Traits.aspx?ID=555) 15 **Fire Healing** As long as a magma worm is in contact with a fire or body of magma at least as large as itself, it gains [fast healing](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=62) 20. When struck by a magical [fire](/Traits.aspx?ID=604) effect from anything other than itself, a magma worm regains Hit Points equal to half the fire damage the effect would otherwise deal.
**Inexorable** The cave worm recovers from the [paralyzed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=85), [slowed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=92), and [stunned](/Conditions.aspx?ID=93) conditions at the end of its turn. It's also immune to penalties to its Speeds and the [immobilized](/Conditions.aspx?ID=81) condition, and it ignores [difficult terrain](/Rules.aspx?ID=453) and greater difficult terrain.
**Slough Skin** **Frequency** once per day; **Trigger** The cave worm would be affected by a condition or adverse effect (such as [_cursed metamorphosis_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1479)); **Effect** The cave worm negates the triggering condition or effect by sloughing an outer layer of its skin. Effects from [artifacts](/Traits.aspx?ID=537), deities, or a similarly powerful source can't be avoided in this way. --- **Speed** 40 feet, burrow 40 feet, swim 20 feet **Melee** jaws +36 ([deadly 3d10](/Traits.aspx?ID=174), [Fire](/Traits.aspx?ID=72), [reach 20 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=192)), **Damage** 3d10+18 piercing plus 2d6 fire and [Improved Grab](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=66) **Melee** stinger +36 ([Agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=170), [Fire](/Traits.aspx?ID=72), [Poison](/Traits.aspx?ID=126), [reach 20 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=192)), **Damage** 2d12+18 piercing plus 2d6 fire and magma worm venom **Melee** body +34 ([Fire](/Traits.aspx?ID=72), [reach 15 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=192)), **Damage** 2d10+16 bludgeoning plus 2d6 fire **Fast Swallow** **Trigger** The worm Grabs a creature; **Effect** The worm uses [Swallow Whole](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=77). **Fire Breath** ([Fire](/Traits.aspx?ID=72), [Primal](/Traits.aspx?ID=134)) The magma worm breathes a blast of flame in a 60-foot cone that deals 18d6 fire damage to all creatures in the area (DC 41 [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Reflex save). It can't use Fire Breath again for 1d4 rounds. **Magma Worm Venom** ([Poison](/Traits.aspx?ID=126)) **Saving Throw** DC 41 Fortitude; **Maximum Duration** 6 rounds; **Stage 1** 1d6 poison damage and [drained 1](/Conditions.aspx?ID=68) (1 round); **Stage 2** 2d6 poison damage and drained 1 (1 round); **Stage 3** 2d6 poison damage and drained 2 (1 round) **Rock Tunneler** A cave worm can burrow through solid stone at a Speed of 20 feet. It can leave a tunnel if it desires, and it usually does. **[Swallow Whole](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=77)** ([Attack](/Traits.aspx?ID=15)) Huge, 3d10+10 bludgeoning plus 2d6 fire, Rupture 36 **Thrash** The worm attempts one Strike against each creature in its reach. It can Strike up to once with its jaws, up to once with its stinger, and any number of times with its body. Each attack counts toward the worm's multiple attack penalty, but the multiple attack penalty doesn't increase until after it makes all the attacks.
